plain_english: It's hard to motivate weak young men. You can't grab soft cheese with a hook. But those with good character will stick to reason even more when you try to pull them away from it.
original_excerpt: It is not easy to exhort weak young men; for neither is it easy to hold (soft) cheese with a hook. But those who have a good natural disposition, even if you try to turn them aside, cling still more to reason.
